objective: Prevent canonical, retained combined and pipeline design+detail results from accepting generated reinforcement whose strength depths do not match the physical bar layout.
bounded_units: U1 Freeze all three producers, BBS/report consumers and recovery examples before changing behavior.
U2 Add one shared post-generation depth-binding validator and call it at every passing joint producer before returning any combined result.
U3 Qualify public failure/success paths, preserve design-only and engineering-failure behavior, and update affected executable examples.

decisions: Do not infer vertical row spacing or centroid from layer count alone. Multilayer primary or required compression reinforcement is unverified in this generated-layout contract.

For single-layer strength-bearing faces, compare actual generated bar diameter, link diameter and clear cover against supplied d and required d_dash at every station. Explicit and derived depths have the same physical check.

Use InputContractError before emitting a nominally passing combined result, so legacy BBS unwrapping cannot bypass the failure. Pipeline must not swallow this error in its optional-detailing exception handler.
Preserve design-only explicit depths and existing engineering FAIL results. Standalone raw detailing/BBS does not establish strength binding.
Do not silently alter input depths or introduce iterative redesign; users can provide consistent single-layer geometry or use the existing supplied-reinforcement route with explicit layer positions.

The single-case design_from_input branch ignored include_detailing=False. Honor that existing flag by returning a one-case ComplianceReport, preserving the declared return union and permitting design-only explicit depths.

Cumulative caller evidence: smart_analyze_design consumes strength and heuristic estimates without using generated bars. Explicit design-only dispatch preserves that existing result contract. The synthetic CLI sample uses three authored single-layer cases instead of assigning a guessed 16 mm centroid to arbitrary demands.

acceptance_rows.outcome: Original Mu340/D550/d500/cover40/link8/20mm-bars multilayer canonical PASS+BBS reproducer returns a structured geometry error.
All three passing design+generated-detail paths reject inconsistent one-layer depth and unverified multiple layers.
Actual required compression reinforcement must match d_dash; nominal unused opposite steel does not redefine design-only depth.
Coherent single-layer explicit and derived-depth canonical/compatibility/pipeline examples succeed; canonical and retained combined BBS still work.
Design-only explicit depths and existing genuine engineering FAIL result behavior remain intact.
The preserved batch-input fix remains passing; CLI and package examples use physically consistent inputs and surface structured failures.
